title: Here Be Ink evidence ladder
description: Part 2's ladder mode: one world per rung, split into seen, imagined and wrong. The page loads scene.json as usual for the frame, floor, walkable, door, light and start, then draws one rung's files at a time. World frame as scene.json's. URLs are relative to this file. Under stance A nothing here is shown as a right or wrong share; 'wrong' only colours the page.

c.description: the camera point every rung's inputs were cut from, world frame

steps.description: The five control steps in order; R4b and R4r are extra chart points, loadable by URL, not steps.

shareOrNull.description: a share from 0 to 1, or null (this checker has no type lists; the page's reader enforces number or null)

provenance.description: 0 for seen (drawn as photograph), 1 for imagined and wrong (drawn in ink)

matrix.description: file frame to world, column-major (THREE.Matrix4.fromArray); a similarity

imagined.description: imagined splats the answer key does not call wrong

wrong.description: imagined splats the answer key says landed wrong; drawn as imagined, in red when the red pen is on

placed.description: false: the page shows 'not placed' with no splats and no chart point (kill rule 2)

shown.description: x: share of all directions from c the inputs showed

imagined.description: y: share of the scored volume's directions where this world is imagined; null if not placed

seenShareOfKey.description: s: the rung's seen share of the key's scored directions; the chart's reference line runs through (shown, 1 - s)

keyAgreement.description: the instrument's own error: share of the rung's scored in-view directions where the answer key and COLMAP's 3+-view points agree

frustums.description: empty for P, which saw the whole sphere

splatsPhone.description: optional: lighter files phones load in place of splats

map.description: floor-plane (x, z) polylines in metres, world frame
